rows.en: Arthur: "...I see. So Prince Cain..."
Celica: "I don't want to believe it, but it's a fact that Cain
is planning something. And it isn't anything good.
...I'm sorry about before."
Arthur: "No, it's all right. More importantly, Prince Cain can wait.
We need to decide what to do next."
Celica: "Y-You're right. Yes."
Ymir: "...Hmm? Where's Ai?"
Clovis: "She rushed off somewhere.
Probably to see the queen."
Ymir: "I see. Well, I suppose it can't be helped."
Fain: "Right this way, please."
Garyud: "...Excuse us."
Celica: "Oh, it's been a while, Lord Garyud.
And you too, Ciel.
Welcome to Liebhofen."
Ciel: "It's been a long time, Princess Celica.
So Liebhofen is complete already."
Celica: "Yes. There are still a few things we need to adjust,
but it's ready for now."
Garyud: "Where is Her Majesty?"
Ymir: "She's resting in the infirmary.
She isn't injured, and I expect she'll recover soon."
Garyud: "I see. That's good news.
Then it would be unwise to linger here.
We should leave at once."
Celica: "Huh? Aren't there any others?"
Garyud: "I've already sent them to Krondem.
Ciel and I were the only ones left in the fort."
Ymir: "But isn't Krondem just a mine?
I heard its veins had already been exhausted..."
Ciel: "That's right. But Father converted the remains into
a hidden fort. It's built inside a rocky mountain,
so you can't tell it's there at a glance."
Celica: "I see. Then we should head
there for now."
Garyud: "...No. Now that Flamuelk Castle has fallen,
Zigrim is sure to be keeping an eye
on our remaining forces.
It would be dangerous for us to gather there as well."
Ymir: "But will they be all right
if we leave them as they are?"
Garyud: "There's no problem.
They know how to act
at a time like this."
Ymir: "You trust them, then."
Garyud: "Yes."
Ciel: "Then I'd at least like to tell everyone that Her Majesty and Father
are safe..."
Garyud: "...You're right. They'll probably send troops here
again before long. If our people think this place has fallen too,
even they may lose their composure.
Very well. Lady Clasio, can you send an encrypted transmission?"
Ymir: "Yes. As long as we have the code.
This way, please."
Ciel: "If Her Majesty is safe, I think you should head for the Holy Land
without further delay..."
Celica: "Yes. Ymir, is that all right?"
Ymir: "Huh? Oh, yes. That's right."
Celica: "All right, then. Set course for the Holy Land."
Baren: "...Understood. Setting course for the Holy Land.
Liebhofen, departing."
Ciel: "Oh, and if possible, could someone
show me to Her Majesty?"
Celica: "Oh, of course. I'll show you the way."
Garyud: "Then I would like to come along as well."
Clovis: "Come to think of it, we haven't properly
visited her either. Let's all go."
Arthur: "Wouldn't we be imposing if we all descended on her at once?"
Clovis: "It's more fun with a crowd.
Come on, Touya. You're coming too."
Yamato: "...You don't have to invite us from
so far away, you know. Why don't you come over here?"
Clovis: "I-I can stand where I like... L-Let's go!"
Arthur: "Good grief..."
Ai: "They don't look all that great, but...
The taste will be fine. Yeah, probably.
...Maybe I should taste one after all?
No, eating one before the person they're for
would be rude. Besides, there's no way they're bad.
Now, I wonder if Alforina's awake..."
Ai: "Hi there! How are you? Feeling... better?"
Ai: "Ugh, what's... that smell...?"
Ai: "A-Alforina..."
Ai: "Nooooooo!!"
Fain: "If only Lord Tyron were here, everything would be perfect."
Garyud: "Yes. To make himself a shield
so Her Majesty could escape... That's just like him."
Ciel: "Father..."
Reduce: "But they haven't confirmed finding his body,
so we can't say he's dead yet..."
Garyud: "You're right. I, too..."
Ai: "Noooooooo!!"
Celica: "?! What was that scream?!"
Yamato: "That's Ai! From the infirmary!"
Touya: "Something's really wrong! Let's go!"
Garyud: "!!"
Ciel: "Y-Your Majesty!!"
Touya: "This... can't be..."
Ciel: "N-No..."
Reduce: "Ghh... Your Majesty..."
Ai: "Hey, this is a joke, right...? Alforina...
Open your eyes... Please..."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "Come on... You can't do this...
You promised... We'd make them together...
It means nothing if it's just me...
You haven't even tried them yet... Come on...
Please..."
Touya: "Ai..."
Ai: "Hey, it's strange. Her body's so cold...
I've got to warm her up right away...
Then will she open her eyes?"
Ymir: "Ai..."
Touya: "..."
Ai: "...Alforina... Alfori...
It can't... Ugh... Uhh... Waaaaaaaah!!"
